# Charlizi Factory — Intimate Apparel OEM/ODM Manufacturer

> Professional lingerie, shapewear, and intimate apparel manufacturer based in Shenzhen, China.
> OEM/ODM services since 2018. BSCI & OEKO-TEX certified. 200+ skilled workers,
> 5,000㎡ facility, 5,000,000+ pcs annual output. Serving DTC brands and retailers across
> North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. MOQ 200-300 pcs per design.

## Core Services
- [OEM Manufacturing](https://charlizi.com/products): Full-service OEM for bras, bra sets, panties, shapewear, and sleepwear
- [ODM / Custom Development](https://charlizi.com/process): Design-to-delivery custom development for intimate apparel
- [Samples & Quotes](https://charlizi.com/contact): Small-batch sample requests; MOQ 200-300 pcs per design

## Product Lines
- [Bra Sets](https://charlizi.com/products/bra-sets): Underwire and wirefree matching sets
- [Bras](https://charlizi.com/products/bras): Underwire, wirefree, seamless, and molded styles
- [Plus Size Bras](https://charlizi.com/products/plus-size-bras): Full-bust and plus-size engineered support
- [Panties](https://charlizi.com/products/panties): Bikini, thong, seamless, high waist, mid rise
- [Silicone Bras](https://charlizi.com/products/silicone-bras): Adhesive silicone bras, strap-on petals, nipple covers
- [Shapewear](https://charlizi.com/products/shapewear): Full body shapers and waist cinchers
- [Sleepwear & Dresses](https://charlizi.com/products/sleepwear): Custom development only, MOQ 300 pcs

## Certifications & Compliance
- BSCI — social compliance audit, passed annually
- OEKO-TEX — all fabrics tested for harmful substances
- ISO 9001 — quality management system certified
- FAMA — Disney Facility and Merchandise Authorization
- Sedex — ethical supply chain assessment (optional)

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2018
- Location: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Facility: 5,000 ㎡ | Staff: 200+ | Annual output: 5,000,000+ pcs
- MOQ: 200-300 pcs per design | Samples: available
- Target markets: North America, Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia
- Sample request / quote response: within 24 hours
